description: Estimate what a charge costs in EUR at public chargers in Lithuania, per charging network, at each network's typical (median) ad hoc price incl. VAT. Give either `kwh` (energy to add) or `car_battery_kwh` with `from_pct` and `to_pct`. Without `operator` returns the cheapest networks, the most expensive one and the national typical price. Excludes per-minute or session fees, which `extra_fees: true` flags.

car_battery_kwh.description: Usable battery capacity, kWh, e.g. 58 for a VW ID.3 Pro.

from_pct.description: State of charge at the start, %. Default 20.

kwh.description: Energy to add, kWh. Alternative to car_battery_kwh.

operator.description: Charging network name or slug, to price one network only.

power_class.description: Price class: "ac" = AC charging (usually up to 22 kW), "dc" = DC fast charging under 150 kW, "hpc" = high-power DC at 150 kW or more.

to_pct.description: State of charge at the end, %. Default 80.

name: charging_cost
title: EV charging cost calculator

description: The cheapest public EV charging in Lithuania for a price class (ac, dc or hpc), in EUR/kWh incl. VAT. Give `city` for the cheapest stations there, or `route` {from, to} for the cheapest stations along a driving route (within 2 km of it). With neither, returns the national ranking of charging networks by price plus the cheapest stations in the country. Each result has a `source_url` to cite.

city.description: City or town in Lithuania, e.g. "Kaunas" (or "Kaune").

power_class.description: Price class: "ac" = AC charging (usually up to 22 kW), "dc" = DC fast charging under 150 kW, "hpc" = high-power DC at 150 kW or more.

route.description: A driving route inside Lithuania. Slower than `city`; rate limited.

from.description: Start: a Lithuanian town or address, e.g. "Vilnius".

to.description: Destination: a Lithuanian town or address, e.g. "Klaipėda".

name: cheapest_charging
title: Cheapest EV charging in Lithuania

description: Hourly WHOLESALE electricity prices for Lithuania (Nord Pool day-ahead, LT bidding zone) for today or tomorrow, in euro cents per kWh EXCLUDING VAT, by Europe/Vilnius hour, with the daily average and the cheapest and dearest hour. Useful for timing home charging on a dynamic tariff. Not a retail or public charging price. Tomorrow's prices are published around 14:00 Vilnius time. Ask resolution "15min" for the quarter-hour prices (96 a day since 2025-10-01), which show short dips the hourly average hides.

resolution.description: "15min" adds the quarter-hour prices as [HH:MM, ct/kWh] pairs and the cheapest and dearest quarter-hour. Default "hour".

name: electricity_price
title: Nord Pool electricity price, Lithuania

description: Find public EV charging stations in Lithuania near a point (lat/lng) or in a city, with current prices in EUR/kWh incl. VAT, max power in kW, connector types and live free charge points. With `near` results are sorted by distance; otherwise cheapest first (in `power_class` when given). Each station has a `source_url` to cite. Coverage: Lithuania only.

available_only.description: Only stations with at least one charge point reported free right now.

city.description: City or town in Lithuania, e.g. "Vilnius", "Kaunas", "Klaipėda". Inflected forms like "Kaune" work too.

max_price_eur_kwh.description: Maximum price, EUR per kWh incl. VAT (in `power_class` when given).

near.description: Search around this point. Use instead of `city` when you know coordinates.

operator.description: Charging network name or slug, e.g. "Ignitis ON", "Eldrive".

power_class.description: Price class: "ac" = AC charging (usually up to 22 kW), "dc" = DC fast charging under 150 kW, "hpc" = high-power DC at 150 kW or more. Only stations with a price in this class are returned.

standard.description: Connector standard the station must have.

name: find_stations
title: Find EV charging stations in Lithuania

description: Current prices of one EV charging network (operator) in Lithuania: minimum and typical EUR/kWh incl. VAT for AC, DC (<150 kW) and HPC (≥150 kW), extra per-minute, parking and session fees, and subscription plans where the operator publishes them. Accepts a brand, legal name or slug, e.g. "Ignitis ON", "Eldrive", "ignitis-on".

operator.description: Charging network brand, legal name or slug, e.g. "Ignitis ON", "Eldrive", "ignitis-on".

name: operator_tariffs
title: Charging network tariffs

description: Significant changes of public EV charging prices in Lithuania since a date, per charging network and price class (ac, dc, hpc), newest first: from/to EUR/kWh incl. VAT and the change in %. "median" means the network's median station price moved; "partial" means many stations were repriced but the median held. History goes back at most 365 days.

operator.description: Charging network name or slug, to list one network only.

since_date.description: Earliest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Vilnius). At most 365 days back.

name: price_changes
title: EV charging price changes
